Search request with max_results parameter limiting response count

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import SearchRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = SearchRequest.from_json("{\"max_results\":2,\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"Rust programming\"}")
    result = await client.search(req)
    print(result.results)

asyncio.run(main())
```
